Subject: operator algebras | ID: 61054

Lemma

If G is a compact group and pi: G -> GL(V) is a affine representation, then V decomposes as a direct sum of irreducible representations.

Proof

Step 1. By the integrable spectral theorem, we decompose \(B_{01320011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the integrable spectral family.

Step 2. By the degenerate spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01320012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the degenerate spectral family.

Step 3. The positive functional \(\Phi_{01320013}\) on the Besov space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01320013}\| \leq C_01320013\) by the positive embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via Laplace interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
